relations.text: Rapid7は2025年11月に、Microsoftとの提携拡大を発表した
relations.text_en: In November, Rapid7 announced an expanded partnership with Microsoft

source.label: Rapid7 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • In November, Rapid7 announced an expanded partnership with Microsoft to advance modern detection and response, bringing together Rapid7’s SOC expertise with Microsoft’s security ecosystem to simplify operations, strengthen protection, and unlock new value for joint customers.

relations.text: Rapid7は2026年5月に、OpenAIのTrusted Access for Cyber(TAC)プログラムへのアクセスを発表し、GPT-5.5などのモデルをAgentic SOCに組み込み、誤検知キューの処理時間を25%短縮するとした
relations.text_en: In May, Rapid7 announced access to OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program, integrating frontier models such as GPT-5.5 into its Agentic SOC workflows to reduce false-positive queue times by 25%

source.label: Rapid7 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • In May, Rapid7 announced access to OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program, integrating frontier models such as GPT-5.5 into its Agentic SOC workflows to accelerate telemetry triage and reduce false-positive queue times by 25%.

relations.text: Rapid7は2025年6月25日に、JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.を管理代理人とし、200.0百万ドルのリボルビング・クレジット・ファシリティを提供するクレジット契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On June 25, 2025 Rapid7 entered into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent providing a $200.0 million revolving credit facility

source.label: Rapid7 10-K
source.quote: On June 25, 2025 (the "Closing Date"), we entered into a credit agreement (the "Credit Agreement"), by and among us, Rapid7 LLC, the lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, that provides for a $ 200.0 million revolving credit facility with a letter of credit sublimit of $ 20.0 million.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

source.label: Qualys 10-K
source.quote: We compete with large and small public companies, such as CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Rapid7, and Tenable Holdings, as well as privately held security providers including Invicti, Tanium, and Wiz (which has announced a pending acquisition by Google).
